title: Sft Data Quality Alignment
definition: The importance of high-quality, style-consistent Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data that aligns with the target personality for successful character/personality training.

difficulty_levels.beginner: In character/personality training, a few hundred to a few thousand well-selected and consistent examples usually outperform tens of thousands of inconsistent or noisy ones.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Quality data, such as highly style-consistent dialogue pairs, is crucial for SFT to teach the model the 'grammar' of the personality, which allows DPO to refine the model's preferences.
difficulty_levels.expert: SFT data quality and alignment with the target personality are essential for successful character/personality training because noisy data can lead the model to learn the inconsistencies in the training data instead of the desired personality.

extra_fields.insight: The importance of quality over quantity in personality training data.
